definition: Passes on information or updates to the group.
apply_when: Announcements, forwarded posts, stall closures or openings, opening hours, links to earlier information.
do_not_apply_when: The message is mainly an opinion of the food (use judging-food).

definition: Asks the group for information, help or clarification.
apply_when: A genuine question about stalls, people, events or the group itself.
do_not_apply_when: The question is rhetorical and the message is really complaining or joking (code what it is doing instead).

definition: Recommends, reviews or rates food or stalls.
apply_when: Praise, criticism or comparisons of food or stalls, e.g. "best in the east", "overrated".
do_not_apply_when: Facts about a stall with no opinion (use sharing-news).

definition: Recalls the past: earlier experiences, stalls that have gone, how things used to be.
apply_when: Personal or shared memories, nostalgia, "remember when".
do_not_apply_when: Pointing to an earlier chat message only as a source of information (use sharing-news).

definition: Expresses frustration, objection or criticism about people, platforms or changes.
apply_when: Objecting to how something was done; frustration with a platform, a trend or a person.
do_not_apply_when: The criticism is only about how the food tastes (use judging-food).

definition: Concerns how the group runs: admin actions, rules, and what members may share or should do.
apply_when: Requests to the admin, pinning, telling someone off ("scroll up"), agreeing not to share, debates about where content belongs.
do_not_apply_when: The admin is only mentioned in passing.

definition: Something interesting that the codes above don't capture.
apply_when: A recurring idea, tension or practice. Give it a short provisional label, e.g. other: credit.
do_not_apply_when: Use only when you can name what it is. Don't use it as a dumping ground.
